patches.rationale: Retain reported TS1321 while recovering valid yield constituents; expose a computation-free completed-file observation for the scoped-diagnostics work guard.
patches.remove_when: Drop the semantic hunk independently when an official upstream equivalent passes the permanent controls and completes the raw checker audit with zero unmeasured cases. Retain the read-only observation hunk only until an intended upstream completed-file query exists. Review and re-hash the remaining patch at each change.

patches.rationale: Restore merge_compiler_options' public visibility (crate-private since the move into parsinghelpers): nts's ExtendedConfigCache observer merges extended config sources under per-option provenance, on upstream's own merge semantics.
patches.remove_when: Upstream exposes the merge, or an extended-config observer API that subsumes it, publicly again. Review and re-hash at each change.
